title: Parsed play
description: Deterministic parser output: scenes made of ordered lines.

kind.description: verse = spoken/recited text line (one paragraph in a prose scene); direction = stage direction (parenthesised or italic setting text); cast = list of characters under a scene heading

speaker.description: Cast id from work.toml [speakers], null when nobody speaks (e.g. Dedicatoria, directions)

speaker_note.description: Inline note in the speaker heading, e.g. 'solo', 'aterrado'

speech.description: Index of the speech (speaker turn) within the scene; directions get the index of the speech they occur in or precede

stanza.description: Stanza index within the speech (blank line = new stanza)

indent.description: Leading spaces beyond the base verse indent (split verse lines are deeply indented)

text.description: Text with markup removed (_italics_ underscores stripped)

src_line.description: 1-based line number in the raw Gutenberg file
